contract: Config.TownNpcs.List: Bright + Sir Gleam (tag StoryNpc, NpcId, 'Talk' prompt with StoryNpcId, G, tap, 10 studs), four townsfolk (tag TownFolk, no prompt), the Halo potion seller (tag PotionMerchant + the shop prompt, off until ShopService accepts more than one seller), Otto 4 studs behind the Crossroads anvil (decorative). Temporary default R15 bodies from a HumanoidDescription (sleeves, trousers), anchored, no collision, no scripts; the height comes from a ground ray (floor-like hits only, never the NPC folder or a player's character), feet on the ground, facing the Look point; reused / repaired / moved when they exist, a foreign model under the name is never touched, a missing ground skips only that body; built after MapBuilder.Build returns.
limitations: The real avatar call, the real ray and the Studio tree are doubles. The look of the bodies and the spots on the final Halo layout are checked by eye in the main Studio (메인 반영 1).
